```{r message = F}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Problem 1 

## Write a function to assess birthday overlap in a room of `n` people. 

```{r}
source("source/birthday_overlap.R")
```

## Run the function 10,000 times for group sizes of 2 - 50 people. 

```{r}
birthday_results_df = 
  expand_grid(
    number_of_people = 2:50, 
    iter = 1:10000 
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    repeated = map_lgl(number_of_people, birthday_overlap)
  )
```

## Plot showing the probability of birthday overlap as a function of group size 

```{r}
birthday_results_df |> 
  group_by(number_of_people) |> 
  summarize(prob_of_repeat = mean(repeated)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = number_of_people, y = prob_of_repeat)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()  +
  labs(
    title = "Probability of Shared Birthdays in Different Group Sizes", 
    x = "Number of People", 
    y = "Probability of Shared Birthday") +
  theme_minimal()
```

In a room of 23 people, there is a ~50% chance that two people will share a birthday. This probability increases steadily as the number of people in the room increases.

## Iterate over file names and read in data for each participant 

```{r}
#participants_df |> 
#  mutate(
 #   data = map(file_name, data_import))
```

```{r}
data_import = 
  read_csv("data/con_01.csv") |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  pivot_longer(
    week_1:week_8,
    names_to = "week", 
    values_to = "data"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    week = str_replace(week, "week_", " "))
```


```{r}
data_import = function() {
  
  data_df = 
    read_csv("data") |> 
    janitor::clean_names() |> 
    pivot_longer(
      week_1:week_8,
      names_to = "week", 
      values_to = "data"
      ) |> 
    mutate(
      week = str_replace(week, "week_", " "))
  
  return(data_df)
  }
```
